sentences.en: COLIN: I haven't seen you for a bit, Marie.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我有一阵子没见到你了，Marie。

sentences.en: MARIE: No.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 是啊。

sentences.en: I've been busy with my project.
sentences.zh: 我一直在忙我的项目。

sentences.en: COLIN: You're making a vegan alternative to eggs, aren't you?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 你在研制一种植物性蛋类替代品，对吧？

sentences.en: Something that doesn't use animal products?
sentences.zh: 一种不使用动物成分的产品？

sentences.en: MARIE: Yes.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm using chickpeas. had two main aims when I first started looking for an alternative to eggs, but actually I've found chickpeas have got more advantages.
sentences.zh: 我用的是鹰嘴豆。刚开始寻找蛋类替代品时，我主要有两个目标，但事实上我发现鹰嘴豆具备更多优势。

sentences.en: COLIN: Right.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好的。

sentences.en: MARIE: But how about your project on reusing waste food - you were looking at bread, weren't you?
sentences.zh: MARIE: 那你那个关于再利用废弃食物的项目呢——你之前研究的是面包，对吧？

sentences.en: COLIN: Yes.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 对。

sentences.en: It's been hard work, but I've enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 这活儿挺费劲，但我乐在其中。

sentences.en: The basic process was quite straightforward - breaking the stale bread down to a paste then reforming it.
sentences.zh: 基本工艺其实相当简单——先把陈旧面包打成糊状，再重新塑形。

sentences.en: MARIE: But you were using 3-D printing, weren't you, to make the paste into biscuits?
sentences.zh: MARIE: 但你当时是用3D打印技术把面糊制成饼干的，对吧？

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah, I'd used that before, but in this project, I had time to play around with /22 different patterns for the biscuits and finding how I could add fruit and vegetables to make them a more appetising colour, and I was really pleased with what I managed to produce.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 没错，我以前就用过这种技术；不过这次项目中，我有充足时间尝试22种不同的饼干图案，并探索如何添加水果和蔬菜，使成品呈现更诱人的色泽；最终成果令我非常满意。

sentences.en: MARIE: It must've been a great feeling to make something appetising out of bits of old /22 bread that would've been thrown away otherwise.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 把原本会被丢弃的陈旧面包变成美味可口的食物，一定很有成就感吧。

sentences.en: COLIN: It was.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I'm hoping that some of the restaurants in town will be interested in the biscuits.
sentences.zh: 我还希望镇上一些餐馆会对这些饼干感兴趣。

sentences.en: I'm going to send them some samples.
sentences.zh: 我打算给他们寄送一些样品。

sentences.en: MARIE: I came across something on the internet yesterday that might interest you.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 昨天我在网上看到一则可能让你感兴趣的信息。

sentences.en: It was a company that's developed touch-sensitive sensors for food labels.
sentences.zh: 那是一家已研发出食品标签触敏传感器的公司。

sentences.en: COLIN: Mmm?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 嗯？

sentences.en: MARIE: It's a special sort of label on the food package.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 这是一种贴在食品包装上的特殊标签。

sentences.en: When the label's smooth, the food is fresh and then when you can feel bumps on the label, that means the food's gone bad.
sentences.zh: 当标签表面光滑时，说明食品新鲜；而当你能摸到标签上有凸起的小点时，则意味着食品已变质。

sentences.en: It started off as a project to a help visually impaired people know whether food was fit to eat or not.
sentences.zh: 这项技术最初是一个旨在帮助视障人士判断食品是否仍可食用的项目。

sentences.en: COLIN: Interesting.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 很有意思。

sentences.en: So just solid food?
sentences.zh: 所以只适用于固体食品吗？

sentences.en: MARIE: No, things like milk and juice as well.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 不，像牛奶和果汁这类液体食品也适用。

sentences.en: But actually, I thought it might be really good /24 for drug storage in hospitals and pharmacies.
sentences.zh: 不过，我觉得它其实非常适合医院和药房用于药品储存。

sentences.en: COLIN: Right.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好的。

sentences.en: And coming back to food, maybe it'd be possible to use it for other things besides freshness.
sentences.zh: 再回到食品领域，或许这种技术还能用于其他用途，而不单是判断新鲜度。

sentences.en: Like how many kilograms a joint of meat is, for example.
sentences.zh: 比如，用来标示一块肉的具体重量（以千克为单位）。

sentences.en: /24 Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 音频文本

sentences.en: MARIE: Yes, there's all sorts of possibilities.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 是的，各种可能性都有。

sentences.en: COLIN: I was reading an article about food trends predicting how eating habits might change in the next few years.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我最近读了一篇关于食品趋势的文章，预测未来几年人们的饮食习惯可能发生哪些变化。

sentences.en: MARIE: Oh - things like more focus on local products?
sentences.zh: MARIE: 哦——比如更加注重本地产品？

sentences.en: That seems so obvious, but the shops are still full of imported foods.
sentences.zh: 这听起来似乎显而易见，但商店里依然摆满了进口食品。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yes, they need to be more proactive to address that.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊，商家需要更积极地应对这一问题。

sentences.en: MARIE: And somehow motivate consumers to change, yes.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 而且还得设法激励消费者做出改变，没错。

sentences.en: COLIN: One thing everyone's aware of is the need for a reduction in unnecessary packaging - but just about everything you buy in supermarkets is still covered in plastic.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 大家都意识到必须减少不必要的包装——但你在超市购买的几乎所有商品，至今仍包裹在塑料之中。

sentences.en: The government needs to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 政府必须对此采取行动。

sentences.en: MARIE: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 没错。

sentences.en: Il's got to change.
sentences.zh: 这必须得改变。

sentences.en: COLIN: Do you think there'll be more interest in gluten- and lactose-free food?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 你觉得人们对无麸质和无乳糖食品的兴趣会增加吗？

sentences.en: MARIE: For people with allergies or food intolerances?
sentences.zh: MARIE: 是针对有过敏症或食物不耐受的人群吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Lots of people I know have been buying that type of food for years now.
sentences.zh: 我认识的很多人多年来一直在购买这类食品。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yes, even if they haven't been diagnosed with an allergy.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是的，即使他们并未被确诊为过敏。

sentences.en: MARIE: That's right. iS One thing I've noticed is the number of branded products related tO celebrity chefs people watch them cooking on TV and then buy things like spice mixes or frozen foods with the chef's name on I bought something like that once, but I won't again.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 没错。我注意到的一点是，与电视上人气厨师相关的品牌产品数量越来越多——人们观看他们在电视上的烹饪节目后，便购买带有该厨师名字的香料混合包或冷冻食品。我曾经买过类似的产品，但以后不会再买了。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah - I bought a ready-made spice mix for chicken which was supposed to be used by a chef I'd seen on television, and it didn't actually taste of anything.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊——我买过一种即用型鸡肉香料混合包，据称是一位我在电视上见过的厨师所用的，结果它根本尝不出什么味道。

sentences.en: MARIE: Mm.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 嗯。

sentences.en: Did the article mention 'ghost kitchens' used to produce takeaway food?
sentences.zh: 那篇文章提到过用于制作外卖食品的‘幽灵厨房’吗？

sentences.en: COLIN: No.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 没有。

sentences.en: What are they?
sentences.zh: 它们是什么？

sentences.en: MARIE: Well, they might have the name of a restaurant, but actually they're a cooking facility just for delivery meals - the public don't ever go there.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 嗯，它们可能挂着某家餐厅的名字，但实际上只是专为外卖餐食而设的烹饪场所——公众从不会去那里。

sentences.en: But people aren"t aware of that - it's all kept very quiet.
sentences.zh: 但人们并不知晓这一点——此事一直被严格保密。

sentences.en: COLIN: So people don't realise the food's not actually from the restaurant?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 所以人们并没有意识到这些食物其实并非来自那家餐厅？

sentences.en: MARIE: Right.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 没错。

sentences.en: COLIN: Did you know more and more people are using all sorts of different mushrooms now, to treat different health concerns?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 你知道现在越来越多的人开始使用各种不同的蘑菇来治疗各类健康问题吗？

sentences.en: Things like heart problems?
sentences.zh: 比如心脏问题？

sentences.en: MARIE: Hmm.
sentences.zh: MARIE: 嗯……

sentences.en: They might be taking a big risk there.
sentences.zh: 他们在那儿可能正承担着巨大风险。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yes, it's hard to know which varieties are safe to eat.
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊，很难分辨哪些蘑菇品种是安全可食用的。

sentences.en: Anyway maybe now .
sentences.zh: 总之，也许现在……
